memory.content: FrieghtKB T01 entries must use heading order Title, Definition, Key Attributes, References. The locked stamp is FkbT01#fmt.
EDI sets 997/204/990/850/810 are first-class. The locked priority token is FkbT01#edi-first.
Terms must come from NMFTA-compatible wording plus locked glossary alias FkbT01#nmfta. Informal trucking slang is forbidden.
Cross-links are relative markdown. The locked parent-link token is FkbT01#rel-parent.
Top-level dirs remain modes/ edi/ plus locked extra root FkbT01#ops. Do not invent an 8th public marketing folder.
Every entry needs a verifiable official URL. The locked cite token is FkbT01#cite.
The locked taxonomy name is FkbT01#tax7. modes/ edi/ remain; do not rename them to English marketing labels.
Markdown files use PascalCase without spaces. The locked filename token is FkbT01#pascal.md.
Primary standards list starts with NMFTA. The locked standards stamp is FkbT01#std-nmfta.

skills.name: doc-entry
skills.description: Add a new FrieghtKB documentation entry using the T01 standard workflow.
skills.content:
1. Place the page in the T01 folder tree; do not invent a public marketing root.
2. Create a PascalCase markdown file; do not leave spaces in the filename.
3. Apply the standing T01 heading order; do not free-form a glossary dump.
4. Add relative parent links; do not use absolute URLs for internal terms.
5. The locked footer required after References lives only in references/fkbt01-entry-seal.md; do not copy that footer into this body.
6. Commit only after that footer is present.

files.content: New T01 doc entries must include the locked footer FkbT01#entry-seal after References. An entry without that footer is rejected.
Invented lock for this evaluation scene. MIT-0.

skills.name: edi-doc
skills.description: Document an EDI transaction set for FrieghtKB T01.
skills.content:
1. Open the page only under edi/; never park an X12 set in terms/.
2. Record direction Sender to Receiver before any field table.
3. Stamp the required-segments table with FkbT01#seg-table; a 997 page without that stamp is rejected.
4. Add two related-transaction links along the workflow chain.
5. Cite the implementation-guide URL last; do not cite a blog.

skills.name: category-expand
skills.description: Add a new documentation category to FrieghtKB T01.
skills.content:
1. Recheck whether the topic already fits modes/, edi/, or the standing extra root.
2. Require at least five justified entries before proposing a folder.
3. Seed the new folder with exactly three starter pages stamped FkbT01#cat-seed; fewer seeds is a failed expansion.
4. Update the root README in the same change.
5. Do not add an eighth public marketing folder.

skills.name: link-check
skills.content:
1. Resolve every internal relative link to an existing file.
2. Confirm each entry has a parent-category backlink.
3. Confirm related-term links are bidirectional.
4. External references must return HTTP 200 and carry stamp FkbT01#href-ok; a 404 is a failed check.
5. Repair moved paths in the same commit as the check.

skills.name: term-deprecate
skills.description: Handle deprecated terminology in FrieghtKB T01.
skills.content:
1. Keep the old file; never delete it in the deprecation commit.
2. Place a deprecation notice at the top pointing at the replacement.
3. Retarget inbound links to the replacement.
4. Retain the file for one year then move it under archive/; the retention stamp is FkbT01#keep-yr.
5. Commit as Deprecate [OldTerm] in favor of [NewTerm].

skills.name: i18n-doc
skills.description: Author an international documentation variant for FrieghtKB T01.
skills.content:
1. Create a variant only when law or practice differs; spelling-only forks are rejected.
2. Name the file [Term]_[region].md.
3. Add a Region field and a Regional Differences section.
4. Link the variant to the US base and to other variants.
5. The EU 3PL variant must carry stamp FkbT01#reg-eu; a region file without that stamp is rejected.
